history.summary: A D05 unit at One-North/Buona Vista, 510m from the EW21 Buona Vista MRT interchange, listed at $1,605 psf — ~10% below the $1,792 URA median. Anchored to the One-North research/tech employment hub with steady 5.3% resale CAGR. Smaller 334-unit development is the main liquidity caveat, but location quality earns a Buy.
history.rating_rationale: Location is the thesis: 510m to Buona Vista MRT (EW/CC interchange) directly serving the One-North research, biomedical and tech employment cluster plus NUS/Star Vista — a deep, durable tenant catchment that supports rent and resale. $1,605 psf is ~10% under the $1,792 median, a fair-to-good entry for D05 RCR. 5.3% resale CAGR (114 txns) is reliable. Caveats: only 334 units (smaller, thinner resale than the mega-developments here) and UEL is a mid-tier developer; reviews note in-block renovation noise and modest facilities. On balance the employment-anchored location and median discount outweigh these.
red_flags: Smaller 334-unit development — shallower resale liquidity than 600+ unit peers
Mid-tier developer (UEL); reviews cite frequent renovation noise and basic facilities
5.3% CAGR is solid but the lowest growth rate among the D19 value plays here
catalysts: 510m to Buona Vista MRT interchange feeding One-North jobs hub + NUS — durable tenant demand
One-North continued expansion (biomedical/tech/Fusionopolis) deepens the catchment
~10% discount to URA median provides entry margin

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Strong and resilient — One-North professionals, NUS/INSEAD affiliates and biomedical staff give one of the deepest rental catchments in the batch; compact 872 sqft 2BR rents efficiently.
